content: Aditi Mahajan called Suresh Deshmukh to verify the cancellation of her auto policy (AU-2019-HC) and the status of her refund. Suresh confirmed the cancellation, stated the refund was sent on September 27, 2026, and will appear on card ending 1234 within 2-3 business days. He also advised her to shred the physical insurance card, assured her that the cancellation will not affect her credit score, and promised to send a final confirmation email.

action_items: Customer to check for refund by 1 October 2026
Customer to shred the physical insurance card
Agent to send a final confirmation email
